## Stable tests

| Test | Result | Subtests | Kind | Description |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| [`integrity-policy/blocked-url-redirect.https.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/subresource-integrity/integrity-policy/blocked-url-redirect.https.html) | Timeout | 0 / 1 | TEST BUG | the `Integrity-Policy-Report-Only` header of `resources/report-only-frame.html` has no `endpoints`, and "report violation" only generates a report for each endpoint of the policy (https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#report-violation), so the `ReportingObserver` of the frame never gets an `integrity-violation` report and the test waits for it until it times out (same issue as `blocked-url-service-worker.https.html`). With an endpoint, the `blockedURL` of the reports is the URL of the request, not the target of its cross-origin redirect, as the test expects |
